notes: 275 distinct CLDF sources across crossgram. THE INDEX, NOT A DATASET: nothing is ingested from it. It resolves which release of each CLDF dataset is CURRENT upstream, which is the only way staleness is detectable at all — a CLDF pin is a DOI and therefore immutable, so the question is never "have the bytes changed" but "is there a newer version". 8 licence id(s) are not in the SPDX map and are recorded as needing review rather than guessed.
